page.description: Page is the current page number (1‑based).

page_size.description: PageSize is the maximum number of items per page.

total_items.description: TotalItems is the total number of items across all pages.

total_pages.description: TotalPages is the total number of pages (TotalItems / PageSize).

fields.description: Fields contains per‑field validation errors (usually for 422 responses).

message.description: Message is a human‑readable description of the error.

pagination.description:
Pagination contains cursor/offset‑based pagination info.
It is nil for endpoints that do not paginate.

request_id.description: RequestID can be used for tracing requests across services.

warnings.description: Warnings contains non‑fatal messages (e.g. “this endpoint is deprecated”).
